committee.sub: Morning brief · Sunday 25 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Paid clicks cost A$6.78 each last7 (18 clicks, A$122.11 spend) with zero conversions, and across the whole landing-page test 58 raw paid clicks have produced zero qualified or even unverified enquiries against A$366.44 spent of the A$600 credit (A$179.37 remaining).

The landing page has logged 10 raw ask_cta_click events from 58 raw paid clicks since 6 Oct, but zero review_cta_click bookings, so the primary action is drawing some engagement while the deeper booking step shows nothing yet.

AI Assistant sessions ticked up to 2 last7 from 1 prior7, led by chatgpt.com, though this likely undercounts given Direct jumped from 15 to 28 sessions; meanwhile Organic Search, the only trustworthy unpaid signal, fell sharply from 18 to 5 sessions.
Seven days produced zero leads and zero form starts (formStartsLast7 0) despite 53 visitors, so visits are not converting into any enquiry, verified or not.

actions.text: The landing page has passed 25 raw paid clicks (58 so far), so the headline, offer and calls to action stay frozen unless something breaks.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin a week and 99.6% success: update the copy to match current site stats.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency) are still outstanding and should be added.
